title: Use THESE LinkedIn filters to help your job search 🔎
description:
No one likes a find a great job on LinkedIn just to see it’s two weeks old and has 200 applicants already on it. Using the search filter to “only show under 100 applicants” and filtering my posts in the last week is a great way to find job postings you can still be early to. #linkedin #linkedintips #jobseekertips
